about: Question pairs for the semantic answer cache (python -m evals.cache_eval), on FAA AC 43.13-1B. 'same': the answer written for A is a correct answer to B, so reusing it is right. 'different': it is not, so a reuse would hand B someone else's answer. Most 'different' pairs are chosen to retrieve the same passages as each other, because only those can share a cache bucket; the guard words (numbers, negations, min/max-type words) catch some of them, the similarity threshold has to catch the rest. 'note' says what the pair tests.

pairs.label: same
pairs.a: How much can the outer wires of a control cable wear before the cable has to be replaced?
pairs.b: What is the wear limit for the outer wires of a control cable before it must be replaced?

pairs.label: same

pairs.b: To what load should cable terminals and splices be proof tested before they are installed?

pairs.b: What is the maximum allowed resistance of an electrical bond from equipment to aircraft structure?
pairs.note: paraphrase; 'maximum' only in B, so the guard should block it (a missed reuse, not a wrong one)
